# S52 — TUI: launch a slice from a ready list

Split out of S25 by #107 (ui.launch-split). The TUI launches a slice: the project offers a list of ready slices (ready = open, has a spec, no claim, no unmet dependency; the ! marker in slicer list), the owner picks one, answers the two y/n inputs (well specified, split), and the TUI shows the plan summary (lineup, check command) and the exact ork run command before a y/n confirm (Enter is No; ui.confirm #98). It calls run.plan, then run.start with the plan as Expected, as ork run does (internal/cli/run.go:119). Depends on S25 (action plumbing and the confirm bar) and S12 (a screen with a list).
